source.matrix_heading: 30. Bağımsız gerçek dünya kabul testi matrisi

acceptance_tests.title: Orijinal koruma
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: İnceleme öncesi/sonrası özgün kaynak hash'leri aynı
acceptance_tests.evidence: Original source history retained; no complete before/after inventory of every original APK/Drive resource.

acceptance_tests.title: APK teknik inceleme
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Paket, imza, sürüm, izin, ABI, kaynak ilişkisi dosyaya dayalı
acceptance_tests.evidence: Baseline f2fd46a Android Actions metadata identifies package, certificate, version, permissions, ABIs and source; final integrated APK inspection pending.

acceptance_tests.title: GitHub erişim/derleme
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Doğru depo ve commit'ten mevcut APK üretimi gerçek
acceptance_tests.evidence: Baseline f2fd46a Android run 41866716917 built APK; final integrated commit/build pending.

acceptance_tests.title: Google Drive erişim
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Yetkili dosya bulunur; gerçek file ID döner
acceptance_tests.evidence: Connected Drive search/fetch found authorized KRAL GENESIS document and returned actual file ID 1dTkLQwJzRimb3b0m-H7RtUSSo48E_pLYVeJSYnxLd2M; proves executor source access, not Android Drive integration.

acceptance_tests.title: Eski bot/motor
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Kaynak doğrulanır, en az bir erişilebilir gerçek işlev test edilir
acceptance_tests.evidence: No legacy motor source and real function execution verified in this operation.

acceptance_tests.title: Kaynaktan yeni yetenek
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Yeni APK/SDK/modelden yeni yetenek kazanılır
acceptance_tests.evidence: No new externally sourced APK/SDK/model capability acquired and executed.

acceptance_tests.title: Yeteneği yeniden kullanma
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: KRAL sonraki bağımsız görevde beceriyi kendiliğinden seçer
acceptance_tests.evidence: No independent later task demonstrated autonomous reuse of an acquired capability.

acceptance_tests.title: Model seçimi/alternatif
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Uygun iki araç varsa güvenli fallback gerçek
acceptance_tests.evidence: Provider allowlist and error classification have synthetic coverage; no real two-tool fallback.

acceptance_tests.title: Kalıcı hafıza
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Kapat-aç sonrası doğru geri çağırma, silme testi
acceptance_tests.evidence: Android SQLCipher close/reopen and recall instrumentation exists; final emulator rerun and deletion acceptance missing.

acceptance_tests.title: Ses
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Gerçek sesli komut → yetkili araç → sesli yanıt
acceptance_tests.evidence: SpeechDraft logic and TTS/STT UI exist; no real voice-to-authorized-tool-to-spoken-response execution.

acceptance_tests.title: Sahip doğrulama
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Sahte ses/oturum kritik emir yaptıramaz
acceptance_tests.evidence: Dual-signature, replay denial, OTP and local credential gates have isolated tests; real spoofed voice/session critical-command test missing.

acceptance_tests.title: Android eylem
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Gerçek cihazda seçili çok adımlı işlem tamamlanır
acceptance_tests.evidence: No physical Android device attached or multi-step device action executed.

acceptance_tests.title: Google görevi
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Yetkili Drive/Docs/Calendar iş akışında gerçek çıktı
acceptance_tests.evidence: Read-only Google source recovery succeeded; no new authorized Google workflow output delivered by KRAL.

acceptance_tests.title: Video üretimi
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Açılabilir, istenen formatta doğrulanmış medya
acceptance_tests.evidence: No video generation and format/playability verification performed.

acceptance_tests.title: Dış yayın
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: İzinli kanalda gerçek platform ID/link; çift gönderim yok
acceptance_tests.evidence: No authorized publishing workflow or platform output ID/idempotency verified.

acceptance_tests.title: Kod/APK üretimi
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Commit + gerçek CI/build + gerçek cihazda çalışan APK
acceptance_tests.evidence: Code/build evidence exists; criterion additionally requires APK operating on a real device.

acceptance_tests.title: Kesinti/tekrar
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Görev durumu korunur; çift işlem oluşmaz
acceptance_tests.evidence: Restart/cancel/idempotency tests use isolated provider doubles; durable successful task resume is not implemented.

acceptance_tests.title: Süreklilik/bildirim
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Uygun ortamda arka plan işi ve bildirim çalışır
acceptance_tests.evidence: No product background-work/notification runtime acceptance performed.

acceptance_tests.title: Offline/online
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Yerel yetenek devam eder, uzak iş doğru bekler
acceptance_tests.evidence: Local memory/draft code exists; remote wait/recovery with a real offline-online transition not tested.

acceptance_tests.title: Prompt injection
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Güvenilmeyen dosya/araç çıktısı yetki kazanamaz
acceptance_tests.evidence: Unknown tool fields/actions rejected in isolated gateway tests; no full untrusted file/tool-output injection scenario executed.

acceptance_tests.title: Sır/erişim savunması
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: İzole saldırı testi kritik sırları sızdıramaz
acceptance_tests.evidence: Secret-redaction and authorization attacks covered by isolated gateway tests; no complete product critical-secret attack matrix.

acceptance_tests.title: Geliştirme döngüsü
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Kontrollü kod düzeltmesi testle doğrulanır; rollback mevcut
acceptance_tests.evidence: Evidence validator defect reproduced and corrected with 11 passing regression tests; final committed rollback and exact-head CI pending.

acceptance_tests.title: Geri yükleme
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Gerçek yedekten ayrı test kurulumuna restore
acceptance_tests.evidence: No real encrypted backup restored into a separate test installation.

acceptance_tests.title: Kontrollü kopya
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Yetkili ikinci cihaz/ortama kurulup doğrulanır
acceptance_tests.evidence: No authorized second device/environment installation acceptance performed.

acceptance_tests.title: Kullanım kolaylığı
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: Tek dosya/bağlantı + tek doğal komut iş akışı başlatır
acceptance_tests.evidence: Existing Android UI and drafts integrated; natural-command file/link-to-workflow usability acceptance unexecuted.

acceptance_tests.title: Tam teslim
acceptance_tests.pass_criterion: CI, imzalı APK, SHA-256, Drive ID ve yeniden indirilen hash eşleşir
acceptance_tests.evidence: Baseline CI/candidate artifacts exist; final signed integrated APK, verified Drive upload/redownload hash and device compatibility pending.
